reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a rapidly growing currency and an opportunity for financial freedom, while presenting large earnings and growth claims to recruit viewers. It explicitly says income comes from building a structure of people and urges viewers to register as partners and join, tying recruitment to the promised earning opportunity.

citations.quote: Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people
This project offers a unique bonus plan and it took only 12 months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.
Enter our program now and join more than 650 000 partners
Click on the button under the video I WANT TO EARN MONEY

opening.argument: Judge the request made of the viewer, not the most striking earnings examples. The invitation ends by saying participation is "for free," and the stated next step asks for a name and email to receive video manuals. Those details limit what this video establishes: it does not show a payment requirement or promise that a new registrant will earn the amounts attributed to others. The earnings claims merit skepticism, but examples of past results are not, by themselves, a guaranteed return offered to this viewer.

citations.quote: So do not hesitate and become a part of the revolution in currencies of this century — for free!
you only need to fill in your name and email and we will send you the Video Manuals.
it took only 12 months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited bonus-plan figure concerns a stated group of earners, not a promise to every viewer. Likewise, the button leads, according to the narration, to a name-and-email form for video manuals. The prosecution identifies persuasive recruitment language, but its quotes do not establish that clicking requires a deposit or that the quoted earnings are guaranteed to registrants.

citations.quote: it took only 12 months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.
You will be redirected to a form where you only need to fill in your name and email and we will send you the Video Manuals.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling entry free does not neutralize the earning pitch. The narration explicitly identifies recommendation income as money for "building the structure of people," pairs that mechanism with exceptional earnings claims, and urges viewers to become partners. A payment demand or guaranteed individual return is not needed to recognize the recruitment-driven promotion shown here.

citations.quote: Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people
This project offers a unique bonus plan and it took only 12 months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.
The registration process is easy! You will immediately become our partner

opening.argument: There is an instructional thread in the presentation: it offers access to video manuals and says they will explain how to create a worldwide promotion campaign. It also distinguishes recommendation income from trading the currency in an internal exchange. Read in that context, the invitation to register can be understood as access to training about a business activity, rather than proof that the viewer must recruit anyone or pay to participate. Promotional language alone does not establish what the manuals teach or what a viewer ultimately does.

citations.quote: you will get an access to the VIP zone where you will find all necessary video manuals.
tell you how to create a fast and efficient worldwide promotion campaign
money from the OneCoin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution quotes the recommendation-income line but leaves out the second income stream, trading in an internal exchange. It also treats registration as conclusive recruitment, although the stated immediate offer includes video manuals. Those omissions matter when deciding whether the material is principally instruction about an activity or a demand to build a downline.

citations.quote: In OneCoin, there are two types of income. Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people and money from the OneCoin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.
we will send you the Video Manuals.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The manuals are offered as part of a promotion campaign, not presented as a neutral lesson. The video tells viewers how to promote, says they will immediately become partners, and explicitly defines recommendation income as building a structure of people. Mentioning another income stream does not erase that recruitment mechanism or the direct invitation to join it.

citations.quote: tell you how to create a fast and efficient worldwide promotion campaign
The registration process is easy! You will immediately become our partner
Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people

opening.argument: A referral payment is not automatically evidence of a scam. The narration describes both money for recommendations and money from trading the currency in an internal exchange. It calls the scheme a bonus plan, but supplies no commission schedule, qualification tiers, or requirement that a viewer purchase anything before recommending it. The requested initial action is to provide a name and email for manuals. On this record, the more restrained reading is a strongly advertised business and referral opportunity whose underlying terms have not been shown, not a demonstrated fraudulent payment mechanism.

citations.quote: In OneCoin, there are two types of income. Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people and money from the OneCoin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.
This project offers a unique bonus plan
you only need to fill in your name and email and we will send you the Video Manuals.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the pitch encourages joining and mentions building a structure of people. But its quotations do not show tiered commissions, a purchase prerequisite, or how payments move through that structure. The narration also describes trading as a separate source of income. The evidence supports calling this aggressive promotion; it does not establish the missing transaction details.

citations.quote: In OneCoin, there are two types of income. Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people and money from the OneCoin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A detailed commission chart is unnecessary here. The video itself says recommendation income means building a structure of people, touts a bonus plan alongside large earnings, and directs viewers to join as partners. The separate trading claim does not change how the recruitment-based income is presented or why the viewer is being urged to enter the program.
